lead.headline: No claim worth priority; set Golden before Wednesday
lead.deck: Claims clear at 02:00. The Golden swap — 2.7 points in a 51% game — is still not made.
lead.body: Bad news first: Tuten will barely practise (Coen) and is a late-week call; Jacobs is expected to miss two to three weeks with a fractured finger; Taylor gets Anthony Richardson's first start, though McGowan's hamstring hands him more of the backfield. On the wire, Antonio Williams has a real role, but a claim would drop Bloodsports from 7th to last for the season, and he would not start. Let him clear to free agency and decide after Week 12. Make no claim before 02:00. Do make the lineup move: Golden (16.7) still sits behind Gordon (14.0) and kicks off Wednesday 19:00. JuiceJam's Walker practised on Tuesday.
